sloka: अवश्यं करणीयं च शासनं पुरुषर्षभ ।तव चैव महाभाग शासनं दुरतिक्रमम् ।। ७.६३.३ ॥
transliteration: avaśyaṁ karaṇīyaṁ ca śāsanaṁ puruṣarṣabha ।tava caiva mahābhāga śāsanaṁ duratikramam ।। 7.63.3 ॥

translations.english: O best among men and illustrious one, your command is certainly to be carried out and is indeed inviolable.
